$comment: Registry used by scripts/lib/adapters.mjs to generate agent adapters. 'file' is relative to .harness/.

commands.name: harness-setup
commands.description: Pre-launch setup of the agent harness: reads the spec (intake), asks every question once (mode, git, deploy target, secrets, limits), configures CLIs and runs preflight. Run before harness-run.

commands.name: harness-run
commands.description: Orchestrator of the agent harness: runs or resumes the pipeline from plan to production in supervised or auto mode, as configured in .harness/config.json.

commands.name: harness-intake
commands.description: Harness stage 00: read the specification and the repository, propose profiles, stack, deploy target, services, secrets and risk. Writes docs/intake.md only.

commands.name: harness-preflight
commands.description: Harness stage 02: run the doctor and the manual checks that prove an unattended run can reach production, then ask for the launch gate.

commands.name: harness-plan
commands.description: Harness stage 03: turn the spec into requirements, architecture, ADRs, stories with risk markers and a tracker. Holds the plan gate.

commands.name: harness-bootstrap
commands.description: Harness stage 04: scaffold the repository, define commands (install, verify, run, smoke), CI and deploy environments.

commands.name: harness-story-ready
commands.description: Harness stage 05 (isolated, read-only): decide whether a story is ready to start and what it lacks.

commands.name: harness-story-contrast
commands.description: Harness stage 06: contrast a story with the current code and docs before coding, and create its branch.

commands.name: harness-story-implement
commands.description: Harness stage 07: implement a story tests-first (test table from the spec, seen failing, then code to green). Holds the tests gate.

commands.name: harness-story-review
commands.description: Harness stage 08 (isolated, read-only): independent review of a story's diff against its criteria, ADRs and profile.

commands.name: harness-story-qa
commands.description: Harness stage 09 (isolated): QA executes each acceptance criterion in a separate worktree and reports pass/fail with evidence.

commands.name: harness-story-integrate
commands.description: Harness stage 10: push, open the PR, publish review and QA markers on the head commit, wait for CI and merge. Holds the merge gate.

commands.name: harness-release
commands.description: Harness stage 11: deploy to staging, verify, then promote to production with a recorded rollback point. Holds the production gate.

commands.name: harness-report
commands.description: Harness stage 12: write the final run report (outcome, URLs, stories, decisions taken without a human, blocked items, cost).
